about: A session and a fork of it whose file names the copied records by the fork's id, which sorts first. The earlier session makes two calls (1 and 2 input tokens; the other kinds ten, a hundred and a thousand times that) and ends at minute 10. The fork starts at minute 30 with a copy of those records, renamed, and makes one call of its own (4 input tokens). Counted once: the earlier session 3, the fork 4.

events.prompt: synthetic-text the owner starts the work
synthetic-text the owner goes another way
